FN-QN2VG45-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 311
Committee: Economic Development and Sponsor: Representative Margie Wilcox
Tourism
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/03/2025
House Bill 311 as introduced could increase or decrease assessments collected by an
improvement district by an undetermined amount, dependent upon the difference in the amount
of assessment collected by: (1) treating failure to pay in the same manner as a tax lien, as
provided for in this bill; and (2) as provided by current law.
This bill could also increase receipts to county revenue commissioners by an undetermined
amount dependent on the fee charged by the commissioner for the collection of improvement
district assessments, as provided by this bill.
Page 1

FN-QN2VG45-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 311
Committee: Economic Development and Sponsor: Representative Margie Wilcox
Tourism
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/19/2025
House Bill 311 as reported by the Committee on Economic Development and Tourism could
increase or decrease assessments collected by an improvement district by an undetermined
amount, dependent upon the difference in the amount of assessment collected: (1) using the
optional method of collection and enforcement provided by this bill; and (2) as provided by
current law.
This bill could also increase receipts to tax collecting officials by an amount equal to three
percent of the total assessment by allowing the officials to collect a fee to recoup the cost of the
collection and enforcement of such assessments.
This bill would also remove the board's discretion to charge a higher interest rate on the
assessment than the interest rate on the bonds issued to obtain the funds for the public
infrastructure improvement projects.
